component.name: GUPT
component.summary: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted privacy suite — chat, passwords, notes, bookmarks and ephemeral sharing on Nostr relays.

description.p: GUPT is a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted privacy suite built on Nostr relays. A privacy-first alternative to Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp, and Discord — that also replaces your password manager, notes app, and bookmarks.

ul.li: Chat: encrypted DMs and groups with replies, reactions, and mentions
Calls: peer-to-peer WebRTC voice, video, and screen sharing
Passwords: encrypted logins with TOTP / 2FA codes and tags
Notes: private Markdown notes with search and tags
Bookmarks: encrypted page saves with the gupt-mark bookmarklet
Secure Share: ephemeral encrypted file and text links — no account needed to open

description.p: Everything is encrypted on your device before it ever leaves it. Relays only store and forward ciphertext, and your identity is a cryptographic keypair you control — not an account someone else can log, suspend, or subpoena.
No servers, no accounts, no phone numbers.
WebRTC end-to-end call verification with SAS emojis, expanded default relay list, brute-force entropy hints during onboarding, and refreshed store screenshots covering the full privacy suite.

Encrypted passwords and notes streams replace the vault, redesigned bookmarks and chat views, single-use token invites, self-healing relay subscriptions, call and screen-share fixes, and a refreshed profile — plus a refreshed store listing with screenshots covering the full privacy suite.
Vault redesign with table layout and templates, bookmarklet hotlink for saving pages, improved notifications, and UI refinements.
Replace the previous desktop runtime with a lightweight GTK/WebKit Flatpak shell.
